column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the congregation of God (El)” is rendered “the congregation of the mighty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lift up the face of the wicked” is rendered “show partiality to the wicked.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִמּוֹטוּ (“are shaken”) is rendered “are unstable.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you have an inheritance among all nations” is rendered “You shall inherit all nations.”
